title: Cross-mission canonical artifact input binding — governed consume of ACCEPTED artifacts from sibling missions
description: Fixes FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_UNBOUND_INPUT for bound missions consuming artifacts ACCEPTED by earlier sibling missions. listEligibleExternalInputSources proves canonical lineage: validateWorkOpenBindingById (consumer mission<->BOUND WOB<->delegated work item, PROVENANCE) + FULL assertCanonicalWorkforceAllocation on consumer and every sibling allocation (receipt + workstream binding + WDEL provenance + child graph membership/dependency/authority + agent contract); tampered WDEL/forged membership/broken binding/malformed/cross-business/non-BOUND all throw FAIL_CLOSED_EXTERNAL_INPUT_LINEAGE. Full validator reused via late-bound registration (bindWorkforceAllocationProver/bindObjectiveWorkstreamCtor at owning-module eval) — static import would pull business.ts into service.ts's import phase and crash work-completion's module-level MISSION_STATUS_TRANSITIONS read; same function object, unbound = fail closed. F2: producerPassAnchored aligned to resolveProducerArtifact — counts ALL canonically anchored PASS validations (>1 = contradictory, closed) then requires the unique PASS artifact_ids contain the artifact; RUNNING/FAILED/unvalidated excluded. F3: cap on ELIGIBLE set only after filters; 63/64/65 boundary + unrelated tests. F5: authorizeConsumeFetch resolves producer mission from the pinned producer execution row; consumer claims/lifecycle/dependency-digest/authorization stay consumer-bound; LOCAL_MATERIALIZATION + REMOTE_FETCH serve exact bytes and reject wrong producer identity. bindPlanExternalInputs stamps reserved pair_dataflow_sources (1 binds, 0 UNBOUND, >1 AMBIGUOUS, drift/conflict SOURCE_BINDING); requiredEdges exempts only source-bound consumes; assert re-proves CURRENT eligibility. 32 tests on canonical fixtures + adversarial + INT2 production E2E (tick->commit->resolve/pin->REMOTE_FETCH bytes). Regression 407 pass; baseline f4 R5.1-crash identical on BASE 1f6d4af.
